facts.fact: Under PMMSY, beneficiary-oriented (individual/group) projects of the general category get government assistance (Centre plus State/UT) of 40% of the project cost; the beneficiary pays 60%
facts.quote: Beneficiary category assistance (including Centre contribution and State/UTs# governments) General category 40% 60% Women/SC/ST 60% 40% category

facts.fact: Women / SC / ST beneficiaries get 60% government assistance; the beneficiary pays 40%
facts.quote: Beneficiary category assistance (including Centre contribution and State/UTs# governments) General category 40% 60% Women/SC/ST 60% 40% category

facts.fact: In Union Territories the whole government share comes from the Centre (no UT share)
facts.quote: #Union Territories (with legislature and without legislature): 100% Central share (No UT Share)

facts.fact: The eligible project cost is capped at the unit cost in the PMMSY operational guidelines
facts.quote: The eligible project cost for activities covered under PMMSY will be restricted to the unit cost as per the operational guidelines of PMMSY.

facts.fact: Land cost is not funded: the beneficiary acquires land at own cost
facts.quote: No, the project beneficiary/implementing agencies are required to acquire necessary land (in case of non-availability of land with them) at their own cost

facts.fact: The applicant must be 18-60 years old
facts.quote: Yes, the applicant should be 18-60 years of age

facts.fact: One person can get benefit for only one project
facts.quote: One person can apply for only one project

facts.fact: The beneficiary submits a DPR / self-contained proposal to the District Fisheries Office
facts.quote: The beneficiary is required to prepare a Detailed Project Reports (DPRs)/ Self Contained Proposals (SCPs) and submit the same to (DPRs/ SCPs) at the respective District Fisheries Office.

facts.fact: Lease land needs a registered lease of at least 10 years for infrastructure projects and 7 years for non-infrastructure projects
facts.quote: the minimum lease period should be 10 years from the date of submission of DPR/SCP and the registered lease document should be included in the DPR/SCP and a period of 7 (seven) years for non-infrastructure projects under the PMMSY.

facts.fact: PMMSY was approved for FY 2020-21 to FY 2024-25
facts.quote: PMMSY is being implemented in all the States and Union Territories for a period of 5 (five) years from FY 2020-21 to FY 2024-25.

facts.fact: PMMSY was extended up to FY 2025-26
facts.quote: Ministry of Finance, Department of Expenditure has agreed to the extension of PMMSY up to financial year 2025-26 as per the existing scheme design and funding pattern

facts.fact: Budget 2026-27 allocates funds to PMMSY (Rs 2,500 crore BE)
facts.quote: Department of Fisheries, Government of India has been allocated highest ever budgetary support of Rs. 2500.00 crore in BE for the year 2026-27 under the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana.

summary: PMMSY FAQ confirms 40/60 (general) and 60/40 (women/SC/ST), UT 100% Central share, age, one project, DPR, land and lease rules; PIB confirms extension to 2025-26 and Rs 2,500 crore BE 2026-27.
